scenes.setting: Old Neil's house, after: Dunn covers the pained eye with a handkerchief; the search turns up the Alchemical Life notes — 'I can consider drawing my own blood'
scenes.text_anchor: We are guardians, but also a bunch of miserable wretches

scenes.setting: Raphael Cemetery: Old Neil's funeral — Rozanne weeps her whys; the epitaph reads 'If I cannot save her, then I shall accompany her'
scenes.text_anchor: On Thursday morning at nine, the time of the moon. Raphael Cemetery.

scenes.setting: The armory, now Bredt's post: fifty rounds requested where the hand-ground coffee used to brew
scenes.text_anchor: In the afternoon, Klein took a form signed by the Captain to the armory.

scenes.setting: Shooting range, then Gawain's field: grief vented into drills until Gawain — who lost 325 friends in five minutes — tells him to stop, then assigns ten more sets
scenes.text_anchor: The smell of gunpowder filled the air.

scenes.setting: The heavy-aired recreation room on Friday: Dunn calls Klein out — the Holy Cathedral's examiner has arrived
scenes.text_anchor: Friday morning, in the recreation room of the Nighthawks.
